name: SQLite Repository 与原子 Artifact/终态提交

implemented: SQLiteRuntimeRepository and checksum-protected one-way migration v1
idempotent Task plus initial Run and ordered Step submission
Run state transition gate for successful and partial terminal states
atomic SQLite transaction for Delivery, Artifact metadata, lineage, and Run terminal state
same-directory temporary Artifact write, fsync, atomic replace, integrity verification, and failure cleanup
deferred: Worker, Attempt, Lease, heartbeat, fencing, and subprocess recovery
discover-papers workflow checkpoint migration, cancel, and resume
structured Error records and optional Trace
network, Provider, paid service, and live acceptance

acceptance_results.criterion: sequential and concurrent duplicate submission creates one logical Task and initial Run
different payload under one idempotency key is rejected
succeeded or partial Run cannot be published without a readable Delivery Artifact
Delivery, Artifact metadata, producer lineage, and Run terminal state roll back together
failed atomic file publication leaves neither final file nor temporary file
identical Artifact bytes preserve distinct producer registrations

compileall.command: uv run --frozen python -m compileall -q src tests scripts

execution_boundary.fixtures: deterministic local fixtures and temporary SQLite/filesystem only
execution_boundary.claim: W3.1 proves the bounded local persistence and atomic publication mechanism only; it does not prove durable discover-papers execution or recovery.

next_acceptance_point: W3.2 单 Worker、Lease、Heartbeat 与 Fencing
